entry.title: Montecristo Short — Pack of 10
experienceTags: Occasion: Quick Cuban smoke, short break, after a meal
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, earth, black coffee, brown sugar and warm spice are the expected core of this unusually thick small-format Montecristo. It uses the classic Montecristo blend rather than the smoother Open blend, with more tobacco mass than a Club despite its shorter length. The wider 10.6 mm format should give fuller smoke and better flavour density than a conventional Mini while keeping the session compact.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the Short singly at A$13 and the pack of 10 at A$100; Cigar Hut lists the 10-pack at A$79 but is currently sold out. Strength and Quality are provisional and Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
